newsitem.title: MEXICO: Cifra up on Wal-Mart speculation-traders.
newsitem.headline: Cifra up on Wal-Mart speculation-traders.

text.p: Shares listed by retail chain Cifra posted sharp gains in trade on the Mexican bourse on what traders and analysts said was speculation triggered by a published report that Cifra would sell some holdings to Wal-Mart Stores Inc.
Cifra's blue chip B series ended up 60 centavos to 13.30 pesos, in relatively brisk trade that contrasted with an otherwise dull market.

Traders said the speculation was driven by a business column in El Financiero daily which said Cifra would sell its supermarket holdings to Wal-Mart. The report, which cited no source, said the accord would be announced this week.
A Cifra spokesman was not immediately available for comment.
No one was immediately available for comment at Wal-Mart's headquarters in Bentonville, Ark.
In explaining the surge in Cifra's price, a desk trader said: "It's what the paper said. They say the announcement will be this week, and dealers are moving ahead of the possible sale price."
